card.name: Injection route words, esp. subcutaneous
card.fires_on: The first pieces of injection-route words such as subcutaneous, intramuscular and intradermal, usually right after "injected", "sub" or "deep". It also fires on route words like IM.

modes.label: Split subcutaneous
modes.description: The "sub" or "cut" piece of subcutaneous before the rest of the word.
modes.example: Recommended dosage: 400 mg injected<< sub>>cutaneously once every 4 weeks.

modes.label: Other route words
modes.description: Pieces of intramuscular, intradermal or the abbreviation IM, or the word administration after routes of.

card.writes: Little clear output effect; the promoted tokens are unrelated fragments, though they fit the start of route words.
card.plain: It lights up on the first part of injection-route words like subcutaneous or intramuscular.
